recommendation: Keep this source-changing commit. Revisit only if CBCC later wants a broader illustrative value set for Consent.provision.code or normative constraints for treatment-scope consent, which is outside this applied Jira resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-29774 was Applied / Persuasive with Modification and requested an example for blocking a healthcare service type, such as food bank or Meals On Wheels services, by using .code in a provision under the Treatment category code.
initial_application: No prior source commit mentioning FHIR-29774 or 29774 was found, and the combined branch had no existing Issue-Reconcile-Key entry for FHIR-29774. Current Consent source had Consent.provision.code and a provision-code search parameter, but existing provision.code examples were CDA/privacy-oriented and none showed a Treatment-category service-type denial.
additional_context: Consent is active in source/fhir.ini, and the old Consent.scope mapping records that scope was merged into Consent.category. The current Consent model uses Consent.decision as the base permit/deny decision and provisions as constraints or exceptions. FHIR-39597 and FHIR-41456 are already represented on the combined branch as later Consent provision-model and provision-code search-parameter work, but neither supplied this example. THO service-type code 6 is Delivered Meals (Meals On Wheels), matching the Jira scenario.
reconciliation: Added source/consent/consent-example-treatment-service.xml and registered it in source/consent/list-Consent-examples.xml. The example uses category consentscope/treatment, a base permit decision, and a first-level provision.code of service-type/6 Delivered Meals (Meals On Wheels), demonstrating that the matching service type is denied by the current provision exception model.
source_changes: Added source/consent/consent-example-treatment-service.xml with a Treatment-category Consent example denying service-type/6 Delivered Meals (Meals On Wheels).
Updated source/consent/list-Consent-examples.xml so the new example appears in the active Consent examples list.

related_jiras.note: Later Consent provision-model cleanup already on the combined branch explains the current decision/provision exception pattern used by the example.
Later Consent provision-code search-parameter correction already on the combined branch confirms Consent.provision.code remains active and searchable.
